## What problem does this solve?

Describe the gap or friction you ran into.

## Proposed solution

What would you like added or changed? Be as specific as you can (new skill name, which directory it belongs in, trigger phrases, etc.)

## Is this general-purpose or specific to your setup?

This repo is a starter kit meant to be forked and customized. Contributions work best when they're useful to most users, not tied to one person's client/project/workflow. If your idea is highly specific to your own setup, it's probably better suited to your own fork, mention that here if so, and we can still discuss it.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why this one is better.

## Additional context

Anything else relevant (links, examples from other configs, etc.)
